title: Minimum Single-Use Coins
summary: Return the fewest listed coin occurrences that form amount, or -1.
statement: Return the fewest listed coin occurrences that form amount, or -1. Implement `minimum_single_use_coins` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
hints: Descending amount order prevents one coin occurrence from being reused in its own iteration.
Apply 0/1 knapsack updates from amount down to coin.
Pseudocode checkpoint: identify the state, update it once per step, and return only after the minimum_single_use_coins invariant is complete.
Editorial: Apply 0/1 knapsack updates from amount down to coin. The intended bounds are O(amount·coins) time and O(amount) space.
editorial: Descending amount order prevents one coin occurrence from being reused in its own iteration. Apply 0/1 knapsack updates from amount down to coin. This yields O(amount·coins) time and O(amount) auxiliary space.
